source_caption_text:
That “Lemonade” intro takes me back instantly 😭

Every single time the intro of “Lemonade” comes on, it instantly takes me back to the first time I heard Don Toliver’s voice. There was something so different about his tone and melody that it immediately stood out and made the song feel unforgettable.

Released in 2020, “Lemonade” became one of those songs that completely defined a moment. Don Toliver’s vocals on the intro and chorus were a huge part of what made the track so catchy, with his unique delivery giving the song an energy that listeners couldn’t get enough of.

Looking back, it’s crazy to think how much that song helped introduce Don Toliver to a massive audience. Hearing that intro today still brings back the same memories and nostalgia from that summer. What a time to experience it for the first time.

#dontoliver #gunna #rap
